mapper.select: SELECT model_ms / 1000.0 / chunk_count FROM material_analysis_timings WHERE job_kind = 'CONTENT' AND outcome IN ('DONE', 'PARTIAL') AND chunk_count IS NOT NULL AND chunk_count > 0 AND model_ms IS NOT NULL AND model_ms > 0 ORDER BY timing_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT extract_ms / 1000.0 FROM material_analysis_timings WHERE job_kind = 'CONTENT' AND outcome IN ('DONE', 'PARTIAL') AND extract_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timing_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM ( SELECT char_count / size_bytes AS ratio FROM material_analysis_timings WHERE job_kind = 'CONTENT' AND outcome IN ('DONE', 'PARTIAL') AND extension = #{extension} AND size_bytes IS NOT NULL AND size_bytes > 0 AND char_count IS NOT NULL AND char_count > 0 ORDER BY timing_id DESC LIMIT 50 ) recent HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minSamples}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_analysis_jobs WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
